notes.18: Those reaching the correct answer used the sine rule to find angle ACB first then, using the property of the angles of the triangle, they calculated angle ABC . The most common error was the incorrect rearrangement of the correct implicit sine rule equation. Those who attempted to use the cosine rule usually found the length of AC incorrectly.
notes.20: A large number of candidates were able to reach the correct answer. Almost all candidates correctly calculated the area of the square and gave the correct units (cm ). Common errors were to work with 10 as the radius in the formula for the area of the semi-circle or to use 5 as the radius but to find the area of the whole circle. A few candidates wrote 10 × 10 for the area of the square but calculated it as 20. Some attempted to convert the answer to square metres and most of these were attempted incorrectly.
